name: Malayan Flour Mills Berhad
overview: 今年集团主要进行内部精简，将已停止运作的子公司 MFM Feedmill Sdn Bhd 及 MFM Ltd 进行成员自愿清盘，并宣布派发两次中期股息。业务线上未见新合约、产能扩张或业务出售的公告。
overview_en: During the year, the Group mainly carried out internal streamlining by placing dormant subsidiaries MFM Feedmill Sdn Bhd and MFM Ltd into member's voluntary winding-up, and declared two interim dividends. No announcements on new contracts, capacity expansion or business disposals were made for the business segments.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年集团层面主要处理休眠子公司的清盘及派发股息，未涉及具体业务板块的扩张或缩减。
segments.note_en: At the group level, the year mainly involved winding up dormant subsidiaries and declaring dividends, with no expansion or reduction of specific business segments.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: MFM Feedmill Sdn Bhd（已于2019年停止运作并休眠）于2026年11月3日股东特别大会通过成员自愿清盘，并委任清盘人。
actions.text_en: MFM Feedmill Sdn Bhd (ceased operations in 2019 and dormant since) obtained approval for member's voluntary winding-up at its EGM on 3 November 2026, and a liquidator was appointed.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: 全资子公司 MFM Ltd 于2026年8月24日举行最终会议，完成成员自愿清盘，预计在提交申报表后三个月内解散。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary MFM Ltd held its final meeting on 24 August 2026 to conclude its member's voluntary winding-up, and is expected to be dissolved within three months from lodgment of the return.

model_changes.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
model_changes.text: 集团将已停止运作的休眠子公司 MFM Feedmill Sdn Bhd 清盘，作为减少集团内休眠子公司数量的精简措施之一。
model_changes.text_en: The Group wound up dormant subsidiary MFM Feedmill Sdn Bhd as part of its streamlining exercise to reduce the number of dormant/inactive subsidiaries in the Group.

model_changes.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
model_changes.text: 全资子公司 MFM Ltd 完成成员自愿清盘并预计解散，集团表示不会对营运造成影响。
model_changes.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary MFM Ltd concluded its member's voluntary winding-up and is expected to be dissolved; the Group stated there would be no operational impact.
